title: Strategic Alignment Mapper
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners map four storytelling initiatives to the business strategy each supports and see an alignment matrix that exposes coverage gaps.

learningObjectives: Align storytelling objectives with business strategy by selecting appropriate storytelling initiatives for different strategic priorities.
prerequisites: Story Strategic Alignment and Story Business Value sections of Chapter 14

keyQuestions: Align storytelling objectives with business strategy by selecting appropriate storytelling initiatives for different strategic priorities.
assessmentOpportunities: Learner can explain why alignment must be revisited as strategy changes.
